title: Belgium, Holland and Bern engagements
summary: After a layoff in Belgium where he fell sick, the band opened at the Mephisto in Holland, the Pshorr Dance Hall, Bern and Heck's.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: But Bobby Martin and the group, you got engagements to last you for over two years, huh?
Well, yeah. From there we went to... We laid
off in Belgium. I remember it was like day and night. It was not like Switzerland at all. I got very sick and almost passed away.

But we laid off in Belgium. Then we went to Holland. We opened up a show at the Mephisto, on the Binneweg(?); it was a Jazz club. We stayed there for about a month. Of course, in those days we were working for (?) Limited, just...
And then we laid off, and then went into the Pshorr Dance Hall -- a bigger place, you know.
Pshorr Dance Hall. I don't know what that means. We played there.
Most of the time were you playing for dancing? Was the band playing for dancing there?
At the Mephisto it was kind of certain(?)... But then at the Pshorr, it was for dance.
Then after that, we went to Bern. ...(?). . . in Bern. Let me see, then we played Holland, in Amsterdam, at Heck's(?).
